name: Chris Yoosefi
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: Chris Yoosefi is a small business owner and U.S. Navy veteran. His campaign proposes a city jobs portal. He also wants to require more affordable units in new high-rises. He supports fully funding the police and fire departments. He has proposed a city database to track government actions. At a League of Women Voters forum, he opposed a dedicated bus rapid transit lane on Olive Avenue. He called Burbank a "car town" where residents do not use the bus.

items.text: His campaign says he would remove downtown parking meters. He plans to design pick-up and drop-off locations for small businesses. He wants to streamline business permitting. He also plans to create a hiring pathway for veterans.
